roommate.narration: Your roommate is still asleep. Through the end of the world.
roommate.video_prompt: Inside a cramped Stanford dorm room, your roommate in a grey hoodie asleep under a blanket, smoke drifting over them, red emergency light pulsing across the room.
roommate.audio_prompt: Heavy snoring under a wailing siren, glass rattling in the window frame.

choices.label: Leave alone!
choices.outcome_narration: You leave them sleeping and slip out into the smoke alone.
choices.outcome_video_prompt: The camera backs away from your sleeping roommate and pushes through the dorm door into a smoke-filled hallway lit by flashing red emergency lights.

choices.label: Grab your roommate and leave!
choices.outcome_narration: You drag your roommate out of bed. They wake up coughing and run with you.
choices.outcome_video_prompt: Your roommate in a grey hoodie, a blanket over their shoulders, stumbles up from the bed and runs beside you out the dorm door into the smoky red-lit hallway.
choices.roommate: came along: your roommate in a grey hoodie with a blanket over their shoulders
